column1: # Which Record Atlas region (context.json, with the rings in regions.json) each place string this archive prints beside a DATE on a
# person's page belongs to, for the 'at the time' notes (site/src/pages/people/[slug].astro, kit/docs/era-notes.md). The only such
# place on a person's page is the place of a marriage record (site/src/data/marriages.json, drawn in «The marriage record»); a born or
# died line carries no place here. One row per place string AS PRINTED. A region of '-' means: looked at, and no Atlas region clearly
# covers it, so no note. A new place string in marriages.json fails tools/build_era.py --check until it is decided here. Mapped by hand
# against the Atlas's regions, and only where a region clearly covers the place: a town the region's ring does not reach is '-', not a
# guess. erasnap.py then refuses any town whose point (data/era-towns.tsv, column 4 here names the town) falls in a DIFFERENT region's
# ring, or within 15 km of its own region's ring edge (so a town on a ring line, such as Vereeniging, stays silent).
